meta.name: Bitcoin
meta.source: Coin Metrics community network data (to 2014-09-16) + Yahoo Finance chart API
meta.sourceNote: Bitcoin has no exchange, no country and no home metro, so unlike every other series here it is not tied to a place. It also trades every day of the year, which is why it has no weekend gaps. Yahoo carries BTC-USD only from 2014-09-17, so the first four years — the 8.6-cent quote of 2010-07-18, the 2011 Mt Gox spike and crash, the 2013 run — come from Coin Metrics' community reference rate, free for non-commercial use with credit. Across 4,267 overlapping days the two diverge by a median of 0.16% (ninth decile 0.82%), so the single seam at 2014-09-17 is smaller than an ordinary hour of bitcoin.

cpi.basis: US CPI, because this is priced in US dollars
